We randomly select 200 outputs (100 outputs per style) from each of the two datasets, a total number of 400 outputs per model. Given the target style and original sentence, three annotators are asked to evaluate the generated sentence with a score range from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good) on style controlling (S), content preservation (C), and fluency (F).
